total_load_factor.name: 综合客座率
total_load_factor.formula_desc: 仅在 fpa_available_seat > 0 同集上计算 旅客吞吐量 ÷ 可用座位数 × 100%，杜绝分母为0。
total_load_factor.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' THEN CASE WHEN c.is_off_in = 'D' THEN COALESCE(c.dep_dpsr_depe_num, 0) ELSE COALESCE(c.fpa_adult_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_children_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_baby_count, 0) END ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' THEN c.fpa_available_seat ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

arr_load_factor.name: 进港客座率
arr_load_factor.formula_desc: 进港已执飞且可用座位数 > 0 航班的平均客座率。
arr_load_factor.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(c.fpa_adult_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_children_count, 0) + COALESCE(c.fpa_baby_count, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'A') / NULLIF(SUM(c.fpa_available_seat) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'A'), 0), 2)

dep_load_factor.name: 出港客座率
dep_load_factor.formula_desc: 出港已执飞且可用座位数 > 0 航班的平均客座率。
dep_load_factor.aggregate_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(c.dep_dpsr_depe_num, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D') / NULLIF(SUM(c.fpa_available_seat) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(c.flight_task_cd, '') <> 'A/N' AND c.is_operated_flight = 'Y' AND c.is_off_in = 'D'), 0), 2)
